official.domain-heading: Official GFTV site dey end with globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read di address from di end, for di last dot wey dey before di first single slash. Any site wey end with oda tin no be GFTV, even if di name show for front of di address.

official.secure-body: Look for padlock, or https:// for di start of di address. Only share your personal tins for official site wey get safe connection.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) na di biggest furry fandom news channel for Asia, e base for Singapore.
about.body-2: We dey show how furry dey grow so dat everybody, today and tomorrow, go fit appreciate am, and we dey host space so pipul fit learn about each oda and understand each oda.
about.body-3: From house reach di big continent dem, GFTV team na international team, with plenty culture and plenty language.
